records.text: A Druid of the Talon found among several of the same kind at Hyjal.
A Druid of the Claw found among several of the same kind at Hyjal.

At Hyjal, Lady Jaina Proudmoore leads a small force in the defense against Archimonde's Scourge army. She urges others to stand with them and prepare their defenses during pauses in the assault. When Rage Winterchill is defeated, she describes a brief respite for her forces; after Anatheron's defeat, she says her troops are exhausted and directs the next stand to Thrall's encampment.

At Hyjal, Warchief Thrall rallies his force against the Burning Legion after Jaina Proudmoore's troops bleed to delay Archimonde. He calls defenders to hold through the assault and ready themselves for another wave. When his force has played its part, he says the next outcome rests with others.
An undead ghoul at Hyjal Summit.
An abomination in the Hyjal ground-trash encounter binding, identified in its template as undead.
A humanoid shadowy necromancer at Hyjal Summit.
An Alliance footman serving as an infantry fighter. His combat script gives him Shield Wall, a defensive ability.
An Alliance knight whose combat script gives him Rallying Cry, marking him out from the footmen and ranged troops.
An Alliance rifleman who attacks at range using Shoot and Exploding Shot.
An Alliance sorceress whose combat script gives her the spell Slow.
An Alliance priest who casts Heal, giving him a support role among the troops.
An Alliance peasant at Hyjal Summit, with no trade and no personal story.
A Horde grunt at Hyjal Summit who fights with heavy Strikes.
A Tauren warrior at Hyjal Summit who can stun foes with War Stomp.
A Horde headhunter at Hyjal Summit.
A Horde witch doctor at Hyjal Summit who hurls Holy Bolts and sets down a Healing Ward.
A Horde shaman at Hyjal Summit who hurls Lightning Bolts.
A Horde peon at Hyjal Summit.
A Night Elf archer at Hyjal Summit.
A dryad.
A night elf huntress.

Tyrande Whisperwind is High Priestess of Elune and seeks aid against the Burning Legion. In separate appeals, she directs visitors toward Jaina Proudmoore on the front lines and Thrall at his western encampment; one greeting addresses her as Priestess.

Archimonde is a demon who demands submission, dismisses resistance, threatens that the world will burn and calls opponents vermin. At the historical Battle of Mount Hyjal, Nordrassil's power was used to defeat him and drive back the Burning Legion.
A giant known as the Night Elf Ancient of War.
A giant known as the Night Elf Ancient of Lore.
A giant known as the Night Elf Ancient Protector.
A Night Elf Wisp at Hyjal Summit.
Tydormu is the Keeper of Lost Artifacts. Visitors can browse his goods, and he offers repairs.
Indormi is the Keeper of Ancient Gem Lore and offers goods to visitors. She wonders whether rumors of the Infinite Dragonflight are true, saying she has sensed a familiar presence.

place_records.text: You are in Hyjal Summit, the battlefield of Mount Hyjal, reached from Tanaris. Archimonde's Scourge army and the Burning Legion press against the mountain, and the masters here include the demon Archimonde and Anetheron. Lady Jaina Proudmoore leads a small force against the Scourge, while Warchief Thrall rallies his own against the Burning Legion. Ghouls and shadowy necromancers fill the mountain.
You are in the Alliance Base on Hyjal Summit, where Lady Jaina Proudmoore's troops hold the line. Alliance footmen, knights, riflemen, sorceresses and priests stand with her.
You are in the Horde Encampment on Hyjal Summit, where Warchief Thrall's force is camped. Grunts, tauren warriors, headhunters, witch doctors and shamans stand with him.

You are in the Night Elf Village on Hyjal Summit, where Tyrande Whisperwind, High Priestess of Elune, seeks aid against the Burning Legion. She directs visitors toward Jaina Proudmoore and Thrall. Dryads, night elf huntresses and Druids of the Talon are here too.
You are in Nordrassil on Hyjal Summit, where the demon Archimonde stands. He demands submission and calls those who resist vermin.
